Method of Attack: Privilege escalation by loading arbitrary unsigned DLLs into Windows services
Bypassing application whitelisting to execute malicious payloads with SYSTEM privileges
Loading and executing malicious payloads persistently to evade detection
Impacted Systems: Check Point Endpoint Security Initial Client for Windows before version E81.30
Attack Vector: Uncontrolled DLL search path allowing loading of unsigned DLLs from writable directories
Placement of specially crafted DLL in PATH locations accessible with write permissions
